description: Fused FP32 weights lose the conversion to half required by hgemm.
trigger: Load a float32 fused q/k/v or gate/up checkpoint through Linear fkey and execute the FP16 linear path.
expected_behavior: Convert fused float32 weights to half before hgemm.
actual_behavior: LinearFP16 no longer converts float weights, and fused get_tensor omits float2half; float32 weight reaches hgemm, which requires kHalf.

introductions.rationale: Fable identifies this regression in the task changes moving transformations into get_tensor; no execution.

observations.description: Fused FP32 weights lose the conversion to half required by hgemm.

verification.description: Finding transcribed from independent commit 119 verdict, not an authoring-time finding.
verification.limits: BF16 fused weights still use the default loader conversion and are unaffected. No checkpoint or execution demonstrated.

affected_revisions.limits: BF16 fused weights still use the default loader conversion and are unaffected. No checkpoint or execution demonstrated. No descendant interval asserted.
